{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_only = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify QA orders (revenue == '999999.99')
qa_mask = completed_only['revenue'] == '999999.99'

# Remove QA orders
cleaned = completed_only[~qa_mask]

# Compute conversion rates by channel and segment
conversion_by_segment_channel = cleaned.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='channel')
conversion_by_segment_channel.columns = ['paid_search', 'email']
conversion_by_segment_channel['diff'] = conversion_by_segment_channel['email'] - conversion_by_segment_channel['paid_search']

# Get segment counts
segment_counts = cleaned.groupby('customer_segment').size()

# Compute weighted difference
weighted_diff = (conversion_by_segment_channel['diff'] * segment_counts).sum() / segment_counts.sum()

# Print all required values to ensure they are traced
print('Conversion rates by segment and channel:')
print(conversion_by_segment_channel)

print('\nSegment counts:')
print(segment_counts)

print('\nWeighted difference (email - paid_search):')
print(weighted_diff)"}
